operand_fields.length: DMA beat count for memory ops; element count otherwise

completion: Every non-END word is acknowledged only after its selected unit reports done. DMA commands hold valid until cmd_ready and then wait for dma_done.

opcodes.name: LOAD_CTX
opcodes.description: Read 256-bit INT16 activation beats from CTX.

opcodes.name: LOAD_WEIGHT
opcodes.description: Read 384-bit INT8 weight beats from WRAM.

opcodes.name: STORE_CTX
opcodes.description: Write 256-bit INT16 tensor beats to CTX.

opcodes.name: GEMM_W8A16
opcodes.description: INT16 activation by INT8 weight with INT40 accumulation; flags[7] launches the production array.

opcodes.name: BMM_W8A16
opcodes.description: Batched matrix product; compiler selects the production array and retains layout sideband.

opcodes.name: BIAS_ADD
opcodes.description: Saturating INT16 addition with a separately represented bias.

opcodes.name: SOFTMAX
opcodes.description: Max subtraction, exponent LUT and Q1.15 normalization.

opcodes.name: TANH
opcodes.description: Piecewise fixed-point tanh for normalized actions.

opcodes.name: REQUANT
opcodes.description: Registered INT40 to INT16 scale and saturation.

opcodes.name: END
opcodes.description: End a command stream and raise done.
